title.narrative: Enhancing Criminal Justice Response

description.narrative: United Nations Office on Drugs and Crime (UNODC) seeks to improve regional cooperation and coordination on trafficking in persons in Eastern Africa through the development and implementation of a regional plan of action to combat human trafficking. Additionally, UNODC will assist member states to draft and adopt anti-trafficking legislation, implementing regulations, and national action plans. The region does not have an Anti-Human Trafficking Strategic Plan of Action for coordinated joint initiatives. A regional plan of action will be of strategic value to regional efforts at combating human trafficking. It will promote regional stability, harmonization of policies, legislation, and mechanisms related to human trafficking in the region.
